checks.name: Installed plugin opens through the real Paseo sidebar; defaults are off
Preset and all four sliders preview and save through settings RPC
Real screenshot pixels change in both workspace and sidebar; text and pointer events are preserved
Saved background restores after browser reload without opening settings
Surface blending follows light and dark theme changes without replacing the image
Leaving settings discards unsaved preview and restores the saved background
Invalid URLs are rejected and failed image loads keep the last rendered background
A custom HTTPS image can be decoded, applied, and saved
Two clients synchronize host settings; stale saves are rejected and recover after reload
Zero image opacity restores original surfaces and discard restores saved values
Fit and position controls apply; settings remain usable in a 900px web window
Disabling removes every injected surface; enabling and plugin reload restore exactly one layer
No uncaught page errors during the complete workflow
